content: Phase-2 cycle delivered (PR #11, v0.8.0): approval surface end-to-end (closes #3), runner protocol (async-only, polling authoritative), claude-code+codex adapters, operations UI (board/jobs/time-filter), thor+orin production pair on thor Postgres. Self-hosted run 01KZJYNC884FJHZ46XA4TW0MMF completed: 4 claude actor sessions + headspace code node + human ship-review approval (the only confirmed ledger record). Key ops facts: bridges need CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_ALWAYS_ASYNC=1 for real sessions; bridge permission mode blocks git so operator commits approved diffs; worker needs NODES_CODE_RUNNER_{NAME,REVISION,ACTOR_ID} + NODES_RUNNER_SERVICES_FILE envs; actors/runners register via raw DB rows (issue #8). Deviations d1/d2 proposed pending owner confirmation.

Codex-bridges cycle delivered (PR #20, v0.9.0, closes #14): codex-bridge systemd user units live on thor (192.168.1.146:8086) + orin (192.168.1.138:8086), actors company/codex-thor + company/codex-orin registered rev 1, acceptance run 01KZS6XX6EA82PDT8GDN74YCBV completed with 2 proposed claims. Critical ops facts: (1) bridge config actor_id MUST be the registered actors.id row value - ledger origin_actor_id is an FK, wrong id = invisible terminal-commit 500 loop burning a billable session per ~80s (issues #16/#19; deploy.sh now auto-resolves it); (2) codex sandboxes on both hosts cannot exec ANY shell (bwrap RTM_NEWADDR EPERM, read-only AND workspace-write) - sessions are analysis-only until host userns/apparmor fixed (#18); (3) run cancel does NOT reap leased work items - stop loops via UPDATE work_items SET state=cancelled; (4) smoke lane: CONFIRM_BILLABLE=yes examples/codex-smoke-pair/run-smoke.sh; live-test: NODES_API_URL=http://192.168.1.146:18080 nodes run list, web UI at same address.

2026-08-12 double cycle: (1) Engine hardening MERGED as 0.10.0 (PR #22, closes #16/#19): callback compensation+repark, dispatch budget 3/work-item (deviation d1: composes with workflow maxAttempts), terminal-run lease guard, cancel reaps+propagates SIGTERM (0.031s live), api slog logging, actors client keep-alive OFF (single-threaded bridges starve on kept-alive conns - #21). (2) PR #24 open: nodes-operator skill - ANY operator assigns work via bash nodes-op.sh (assign codex-thor "instr" --yes); first use: codex audited repo docs through the system, found real d1 drift, fixed. (3) AWS live: profile culture-nodes = user culture-nodes-dev acct 435593604218 us-east-1, AWS_PROFILE/REGION in .claude/settings.local.json; bootstrap-operator.sh (+update-policy mode) in deploy/aws; PENDING: user re-applies policy (lambda:ListFunctions), then #25 = open the lane (scope cycle over #7 decisions). Ops: cancel now safe; smoke lane CONFIRM_BILLABLE; codex sessions still analysis-only (#18 bwrap).

AWS lane opened AND completed live 2026-08-12 (issue #25, ADR 0006, PR #26, v0.12.0): account 435593604218 us-east-1, profile culture-nodes. Standing resources, all live and verified: SQS queue culture-nodes-awslive (awslive suite green: round-trip + delay), ECR repo culture-nodes/runner (arm64), Lambda function culture-nodes-runner Active running cmd/nodes-runner-lambda (current digest sha256:6bfd11f452a0d8451dfa3b86b3c15b0b34526510f3f14ee2071728576a33e701, includes colleague-review folds: RunnerError vs OperationRefused typing, post retry), roles culture-nodes-lambda-exec + culture-nodes-worker (rendered RenderWorkerIAMPolicy). Lambda awslive suite green against the real function. HARD-WON: lambda create-function on a container image fails until the ECR REPOSITORY policy grants lambda.amazonaws.com pull (BatchGetImage+GetDownloadUrlForLayer, condition aws:sourceArn culture-nodes-*); needs ecr:SetRepositoryPolicy (in dev-operator-policy.json since 0.12.0; human update-policy re-applied it 2026-08-12). Runbook: deploy/aws/README.md. Decisions (ADR 0006): SQS optional signal driver, Lambda stays in-worker adapter (refold trigger: first real cloud target), awslive manual-only never CI, Fargate deferred.
